title: New Orleans players in the band; Freddie Keppard
summary: He wanted Zutty Singleton but Louis Armstrong was forming his own band; Freddie Keppard played with him.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Do you remember many of the people from New Orleans that you worked with? I know Baby Dodd said he worked a few nights at least in that band. I think Zutty Singleton had too.
Zutty, I tried to get low at that time, but Lowey just about that time had made up his mind to organize his own band. And I had Freddie Keppert.
Well, I think of it. I don't like the... Well, the motorists have this on the tape either. But do you know if Freddie Keppert's widow would be living here anymore?
I don't know. I've never... I've never... I never see her, never hear anything more of her since she's passing.
I know his brother, Louie Keppert, in New Orleans.
